en.name: GroceryMatch: Save on Food
en.title: GroceryMatch — Save on Food
en.subtitle: Compare grocery & meal prices
en.short_description: Compare your grocery list across stores, and meal prices across delivery apps.
en.description:
GroceryMatch takes your shopping list and tells you which store fills it for least — and, when it is worth the extra stop, how to split it across two.

—— Groceries ——

BEST BASKET
Enter a list and compare the whole basket across Walmart, Kroger, Target, Publix, Albertsons and Aldi. Not item-by-item guessing: the total for the list you actually wrote.

SPLIT TRIP
When one store is cheaper for produce and another for staples, GroceryMatch works out whether the saving justifies the second stop.

COUPON STACKING
Finds coupons that combine, rather than showing you one and stopping.

RECEIPT AND BARCODE SCAN
Scan a receipt to build a list from what you already buy, or a barcode to price a single item.

MEAL PLANNER AND PANTRY
Plan meals, track what is already in the cupboard, and keep the list honest.

PRICE HISTORY
See whether an item's price is genuinely low this week.

—— Dining ——

The same idea applied to eating out. Compare a meal across DoorDash, UberEats, Grubhub and pickup, with a breakdown of the menu markup each app adds, suggested combo swaps, and current restaurant deals.

—— No account needed ——

Tap "Continue as Guest" and everything works. Sign in only if you want your lists on more than one device.

—— About prices ——

Prices vary by store and region and change constantly. GroceryMatch shows what it last saw; confirm at the register or at checkout.

review_information.notes:
Thanks for reviewing GroceryMatch.

GroceryMatch compares a shopping list across grocery chains, and the same meal across food-delivery apps. Sign-in is OPTIONAL: tap "Continue as Guest (Demo)" on the login screen and every feature is available with demo data. No demo account is needed.

Test instructions:
1. Launch the app. On the login screen tap "Continue as Guest (Demo)" - this is the intended review path and no account is required.
2. Open the Grocery tab and add a few items to the shopping list.
3. Tap Compare to see the whole basket priced across Walmart, Kroger, Target, Publix, Albertsons and Aldi, with a Best Basket recommendation.
4. Open Split Trip to see whether splitting the list across two stores saves enough to justify the extra stop.
5. Open the Dining tab, add a craving, and compare the meal across DoorDash, UberEats, Grubhub and pickup - the menu-markup breakdown shows what each app adds.
6. Open the meal planner and pantry from the menu.
7. Camera permission is used only for receipt and barcode scanning, which is optional; decline it and the rest of the app works.

Privacy:
• Data collected: Your shopping and craving lists, pantry contents and preferences. Sign-in is optional; if you use it, your email is held by our authentication provider.
• Network: Requests to grocery and restaurant price sources to price your list.
• Location: Requested only to find stores and restaurants near you, and only while you are using the app. You can decline and enter a postal code instead.
• Tracking: None. The app does not read the advertising identifier and shows no App Tracking Transparency prompt.

If you need anything else, please email contact@safecodeg.com and we will respond within one business day.
